rows.title: Serum magnesium and major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with diabetic foot ulcers: a retrospective cohort study.
rows.focus: A retrospective cohort of 1,176 patients with diabetic foot ulcers evaluated baseline serum magnesium in relation to subsequent major adverse cardiovascular events. Higher magnesium was associated with lower MACE risk across adjusted and sensitivity analyses, but the authors explicitly caution that the observational design does not establish a benefit from magnesium supplementation.
rows.replacement_for_title: A trade-off between shelf-life mitigation and nutritional retention: a persistent challenge in pearl millet.

rows.title: Clinical Trial: Multi-Strain Probiotic Improves Bile Acid Profile, Microbiome, and Metabolomic Parameters in Patients With History of Bile Acid Malabsorption-A Randomized, Controlled Trial.
rows.focus: In a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in patients with prior bile acid malabsorption, a multi-strain probiotic changed the fecal microbiome and metabolome and reduced the percentage of fecal primary bile acids. Symptoms and several other measures were not significantly different, making the result useful but appropriately limited human evidence.
rows.replacement_for_title: Exogenous regulators that alleviate waterlogging stress in plants: mechanisms, integration, and translational strategies.

rows.title: Safety and immune-regulating effects of Limosilactobacillus reuteri LR08: Preclinical and clinical evidence from a randomized controlled trial.
rows.focus: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled human trial, supported by genomic and preclinical safety work, evaluated Limosilactobacillus reuteri LR08 in healthy adults. The intervention altered gut microbial diversity and selected immune and metabolic markers while the broader safety program found no major genomic or toxicologic red flags.
rows.replacement_for_title: Auxin-rhizomicrobiome interactions as a driver of climate-resilient root architecture: a conceptual framework for sustainable agriculture.

rows.title: Effects of Probiotic and Synbiotic Supplementation on Body Composition and Glucose Metabolism in Children and Adolescents with Overweight or Obesity: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
rows.focus: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 randomized trials examined probiotic or synbiotic supplementation in children and adolescents with overweight or obesity. The analysis found no clear benefit for most body-composition or glucose-metabolism outcomes and only a modest BMI reduction with low-certainty evidence, providing a useful null/limited-effect result for the gut evidence base.
rows.replacement_for_title: Global change-driven plant adaptive strategies and interspecific interaction networks: from molecular regulation to ecological management.

rows.title: Effect of vitamin D supplementation on bone health in Black, Asian and other non-White Ethnic adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
rows.journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
rows.focus: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated randomized vitamin D supplementation trials in non-White adults. Across 12 trials and more than 8,000 participants, evidence for improved bone mineral density, bone turnover markers, or fractures was limited and inconsistent, emphasizing uncertainty rather than a blanket efficacy claim.
rows.replacement_for_title: Iron need attention: a review on the role of iron in plants.

rows.title: Ketone Monoester Increases Skeletal Muscle Power and Energy Turnover in Older but Not Young Men Without Affecting Metabolic Economy: A Controlled, Double Blind, Cross-Over Trial.
rows.focus: A randomized double-blind crossover trial compared ketone monoester with placebo in young and older men using phosphorus MR spectroscopy, dynamometry, and high-resolution respirometry. In older participants, acute ketosis increased ATP production, work capacity, and peak power without improving measured metabolic economy or mitochondrial respiratory capacity.
rows.replacement_for_title: Mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes in canine and feline diabetic kidney disease: mechanistic links and nutritional implications.

rows.title: A UV-Free Strategy for Vitamin D Synthesis in Skin: Concept Verification and a Randomised Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial of a Cholecalciferol Phosphate Patch (TransVitD).
rows.focus: A translational program tested a cholecalciferol-phosphate skin patch after laboratory and animal work. In the randomized double-blind human trial the patch was generally safe but did not produce a statistically significant improvement in vitamin D status versus placebo, an important negative result for formulation claims.
rows.replacement_for_title: A conserved zinc-finger gene BmZFO721 regulates meiosis and female fertility in silkworm, Bombyx mori.

rows.title: Impact of Vitamin D and Curcumin on CD4+ and CD8+ T cells Expressing CXCR3, CCR4, and CCR6 Chemokine Receptors in Patients with Relapsing-remitting Multiple Sclerosis.
rows.journal: Iranian journal of allergy, asthma, and immunology
rows.focus: Peripheral blood cells from people with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis and healthy controls were used to examine immunologic responses to vitamin D, curcumin, and their combination in vitro. Combined exposure reduced several T-cell chemokine-receptor measures, offering mechanistic human-cell evidence while remaining distinct from clinical efficacy evidence.
rows.replacement_for_title: Panax-derived Zingibroside R1 exerts allelopathic effects on root architecture by modulating the auxin transport pathway and oxidative stress responses.

rows.title: Efficacy of a probiotic formula in the management of menopausal symptoms and quality of life: a randomized controlled trial.
rows.focus: A decentralized randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial enrolled perimenopausal and postmenopausal women for three months of a defined probiotic formula or placebo. Menopause Rating Scale scores and one quality-of-life measure favored the probiotic, while another quality-of-life scale did not differ, supporting a qualified rather than uniform benefit signal.
rows.replacement_for_title: Adsorption-coupled PMS activation over waste iron sludge-derived Fe/biochar for sulfamethoxazole degradation: A singlet oxygen-associated oxidation pathway.

rows.title: Comparative Effects of Lavender Aromatherapy and Nature Sounds on Anxiety and Pain in Cataract Surgery Patients: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
rows.journal: Journal of integrative and complementary medicine
rows.focus: In a randomized controlled trial of 120 cataract-surgery patients, lavender aromatherapy and nature sounds were compared with standard care. Both intervention groups showed lower post-intervention anxiety and pain than control, and no adverse events were reported, providing direct human evidence for an acute situational-anxiety context.
rows.replacement_for_title: Dislocation-Based CPFEM and Phase-Field Study on the Stress Corrosion Cracking of Randomly Textured Magnesium Alloys.

rows.title: The effects of acute ketone monoester supplementation on brain insulin responsiveness and cognitive performance: Results of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial in older men with overweight.
rows.focus: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial in older men with overweight tested acute ketone monoester supplementation. The intervention rapidly induced ketosis, changed cerebral blood-flow responses to intranasal insulin, and produced a modest improvement in attention/psychomotor speed without improving memory or executive function.
rows.replacement_for_title: Novel duck reovirus σC hijacks the mitochondrial COQ6-CoQ10 axis to drive NLRP3-dependent pyroptosis.

rows.title: Comparison of the Effects of a Melissa officinalis L. and Valerian Combination With Clonidine on Anxiety, Hemodynamic Changes, and Shivering in Knee Replacement Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
rows.journal: Journal of perianesthesia nursing : official journal of the American Society of PeriAnesthesia Nurses
rows.focus: A randomized controlled trial compared a Melissa officinalis/valerian combination, clonidine, and placebo around knee replacement surgery. The herbal combination reduced postoperative shivering similarly to clonidine; anxiety moved in a favorable direction but the between-group anxiety effect was not statistically significant.
rows.replacement_for_title: Biochemical shifts in Chlorella vulgaris via post-stationary magnesium sulfate stress: optimizing biomass for advanced bio-fertilizers.

rows.title: Aromatherapy with lavender essential oil for the control of dental anxiety in patients undergoing dental surgery: A triple-blind randomized clinical trial.
rows.focus: A triple-blind randomized clinical trial evaluated lavender essential-oil aromatherapy during mandibular third-molar surgery. The lavender group showed reductions in respiratory rate, heart rate, cortisol, and local-anesthetic requirements, supporting a possible role in dental-anxiety management while preserving the study's limited procedural context.
rows.replacement_for_title: Genome-wide identification, evolutionary dynamics, and abiotic stress response networks of the magnesium transporter gene family in foxtail millet (Setaria italica L.).

rows.title: Aromatherapy effects on pain and anxiety during transrectal ultrasound-guided prostate biopsy: A randomized controlled trial.
rows.focus: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 120 men undergoing prostate biopsy tested lavender or frankincense aromatherapy in addition to standard local anesthesia. Both aromatherapy groups had lower anxiety and pain measures than placebo, with no reported adverse events.
rows.replacement_for_title: Adaptive laboratory evolution of E. coli to magnesium chloride stress reveals noncanonical routes to broad chaotropic salt resistance.
